            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_ovd_14d_pls_30d_afn_pk_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_ovd_0d_pls_3d_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_ovd_0d_pls_3d_mrn_pk_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_ovd_0d_pls_3d_afn_pk_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_non_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_mrn_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_mrn_pk_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_evn_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_dwn_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_afn_zd_v2,
            f.stg_pln_sum_rep_prc_12m_his_d0_afn_pk_v2,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.lst_rep_typ_v2,
            f.ds,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_12his_rep_ability_v2_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
